{{Quote|We've got the fighters who survived the Tocan system disaster recuperating in Ghorman; they'll be maybe 75% effective in two weeks. Plus, we can strip Tierfon, Homon and Farstey for the other wing, ''if'' the Imps hold off on their offensive in that region.|Rebel Alliance Chief of Sector Command|<ref name="AHC2" />}}
'''Farstey''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] astronomical object situated in the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], while the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was carrying out an offensive in Farstey's vicinity, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Chief of Sector Command]] suggested during a meeting of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] that the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base at Farstey could be stripped to form a [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] for a planned [[Operation Cobolt|assault]] on an [[Imperial orbital base|Imperial base]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]].

==Description==
Farstey was an astronomical object<ref name="AHC2" /> located in the [[Farstey system/Legends|Farstey system]], a part of the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Trans-Hydian" />

==History==
{{Quote|We've got two wings of X- and Y-wings available during that time ''[&hellip;]'' Sector Command says they can scrape up two more&mdash;''"<br />"''Probably.|Rebel Alliance [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]] and Chief of Sector Command|<ref name="AHC2" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base was located at Farstey.<ref name="AHC2" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], including "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," is set between the end of {{Film|IV}} and the beginning of {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was carrying out an offensive in the region that, in addition to Farstey, included the<ref name="AHC2" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Region">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Homon system/Legends|Homon]] and [[Tierfon system/Legends|Tierfon systems]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Homon">{{CSWECite|II|55|Homon}}</ref> [[Homon/Legends|Homon]] and the<ref name="AHC2" /> Expansion Region<ref name="Region" /> planet<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|122|TIE 1-2|Tierfon Rebel Base}}</ref> [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]].<ref name="AHC2" />

At the 251st meeting of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] held during that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Rebel [[Chief of Sector Command]] noted that the bases at Farstey, Homon, and Tierfon could be stripped of their starfighters in order to form an additional [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] for the purposes of [[Operation Cobolt]],<ref name="AHC2" /> a planned Alliance assault on an [[Imperial orbital base|Imperial base]] located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the<ref name="PlanningMeeting">{{WEGCite|story=Minutes of the Planning Meeting for Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Mantooine">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mantooine system/Legends|Mantooine system]]</ref> planet [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]].<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> According to the Chief of [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]], however, such relocation of Alliance resources could only be done if the Empire did not continue its offensive in the region containing Farstey.<ref name="AHC2" /> Ultimately, the Alliance did draw the starfighters from the Farstey, [[Homon sector/Legends|Homon]], and [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sectors]]<ref name="CSWE Cobolt">{{CSWECite|II|416|Operation Cobolt}}</ref> and carried out the planned assault.<ref name="CoboltReport">{{WEGCite|story=General Madine's Report on Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Farstey was introduced via mention in "[[Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Paul Murphy]] and published in [[1990]] for use with [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AHC1">{{WEGCite|story=Extract of Minutes from the 251st Meeting of the Alliance High Command|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Farstey [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Farstey, in grid square O-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
